Info.subtitle: Marrakech
Info.intro: Stay at the heart of Bailaimos. Find your accommodation and connect with your community between workshops, pool parties and unforgettable nights of dancing.
Info.storyTitle: The festival lives in the hotel
Info.storyBody: Bailaimos takes over Palm Plaza Marrakech, on Avenue du 7ème Art in Agdal. Workshops by day, socials by night, pool and terraces in between. You sleep where you dance, about fifteen minutes from Marrakech Menara airport.
Info.stayIntro: Every pass includes 3 nights, Friday to Sunday. Share an apartment with friends, or take a hotel double room closer to the floor.
Info.catTwoBedBody: A living room to gather, two bedrooms, up to four people. A home inside the hotel.
Info.catOneBedBody: A one-bedroom apartment for two. More space than a classic room, quiet between the parties.
Info.catDoubleBody: The hotel double room, for two people. You sleep closest to the dance floors, with Palm Plaza comfort.
Info.ctaBody: Choose the apartment or the double room, then complete your pass.
Info.empty: Practical information will be published soon.
Info.travelIntro: The simplest arrival is a direct flight to Marrakech airport. Then a short taxi to Palm Plaza Marrakech.
Info.flyBody: Fly into Marrakech airport for the simplest arrival.
Info.trainBody: If you land in Casablanca (CMN) or Rabat (RBA), continue to Marrakech by train.
Info.busBody: From Agadir (AGA), continue by road or bus. There is currently no train to Marrakech.
Info.taxiBody: Indicative taxi fare from Marrakech airport to Palm Plaza Marrakech. Available at the taxi desks at the airport exit. Duration is about 15 minutes, depending on traffic. The festival does not run a private shuttle.
Info.infosCtaBody: How to get here, what the taxi costs, and whether you need a visa.
Info.visaBody: Visa requirements depend on your nationality. Use the official Moroccan checker: nationality, country of residence, passport type, purpose of trip, and whether you hold another valid visa.

items.a: Bailaimos Festival by El Baile is a bachata festival in Marrakech. Workshops, socials and shows, all at Palm Plaza Marrakech.
The festival runs from 20 to 24 May 2027. Stay packages include 3 nights, Friday to Sunday.

The festival welcomes several levels. Socials are open to everyone. Check the programme for workshop details.

items.q: How do I become an ambassador?
items.a: Open the Ambassadors page and send your application. The best promoters receive a pass, a stay at Palm Plaza Marrakech and a commission.

items.q: How do I get to the hotel from the airport?
items.a: The simplest arrival is Marrakech airport. A taxi from the airport desks to Palm Plaza Marrakech is about €14 (about 142 MAD), up to 6 passengers, around 15 minutes.

items.q: What if I land in Casablanca, Rabat or Agadir?
items.a: From Casablanca or Rabat, continue to Marrakech by train. From Agadir, continue by road or bus. There is currently no train from Agadir to Marrakech.

items.q: Do I need a visa for Morocco?
items.a: It depends on your nationality. Check the official tool at acces-maroc.ma.
